semantic_answers.answer: jargon clumps where the writer knows things

answer.phrase: I could almost feel his hard-earned acumen making its way from his brain into my own
answer.why_forced: Maps an abstract, non-physical quality (acumen, i.e. accumulated skill/judgment) onto a tactile sensation of feeling and physical transit from one brain to another, with no concrete sensory anchor grounding the claim.

answer.phrase: like a beam of brilliance from above
answer.why_generic: A stock inspirational image (light from above) that could describe any admired speaker; it names no concrete quality of Rich and Nati's actual delivery.

answer.phrase: the elephant which lurks in every room
answer.why_generic: A well-worn cliché for an avoided issue; it substitutes a familiar idiom for any concrete description of what makes tech-tool disagreements awkward in this context.

answer.phrase: which can be more inclusive and less invasive; timely but not hurried
answer.why_formulaic: A stacked pair of balanced antitheses that sounds conclusive but never specifies what makes async decisions inclusive versus invasive, or timely versus hurried, in this particular group's practice.

answer.phrase: The more effective we can make decentralised teams the more positive change we will be able to deliver.
answer.what_it_repeats: Restates the effectiveness claims already made piecemeal after several patterns (e.g. the steward system being 'bound to reduce conflicts' and tech-tool agreement making a team 'bound to be more effective') without adding new information.

answer.missing_criterion: No stated basis for what made the planning or design good (structure, materials, timing) beyond general praise.
Timely relative to what event, need, or audience is left unspecified.

answer.phrase: enormous strength in continuous participatory change
answer.missing_criterion: No measure or mechanism given for how 'strength' is assessed or observed in this iterative process.

answer.phrase: Brilliant advice which might be hard for some egos to hear.
answer.missing_criterion: No criterion given for why the advice qualifies as 'brilliant' beyond the writer's approval.

answer.missing_context: Reads as a rebuttal to an unstated doubt about whether Rich and Nati genuinely have the experience being credited to them, but no such doubt or prior comment appears in the document.

answer.phrase: Simple, effective relationship building which is bound to reduce conflicts.
answer.missing_relationship: Asserts a causal link between the steward/stewardee pairing and reduced conflict without explaining the mechanism or offering evidence.

answer.phrase: If you can clearly define and agree which tool/s you will be using for each of these three essential areas of group work, your team is bound to be more effective.
answer.missing_relationship: Asserts a causal link between tool agreement and team effectiveness without specifying how or by what measure effectiveness follows.
